description: Eerste Helmersstraat 25-39 (1905): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a cornice at 15.3 m; three axes of windows with a transom; on storeys 1 and 2 each window stands under a brick relieving arch over a red-and-ochre chequered tympanum; white frames and sills; a bellied iron balconette on a bracketed slab on the centre axis of storeys 1-3; a white timber dormer with a gabled cap over the centre

pointed-dormer.note: 27-39: one white timber dormer with a gabled cap over the centre

door-left.note: 35: house door on the left axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door left or right
rhythm.roofline: cornice at 15.3 m; one white gabled dormer

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 25-39 (1905), 5.5-6.5 m; cornice 15.3 m on the 2023-01-12 strip; the skyline reads the white dormer tops at 17.2-17.4 m (frontSkylineM)
